prerequisites: Preliminary knowledge of Mathematical Analysis (study of functions, techniques of derivation and integration of functions of one or more variables)
Geometry (vector spaces and linear applications, matrices and linear applications, linear systems, algebraic curves: conics)
Physics and Rational Mechanics (vector calculus, cardinal equations of statics)

learning_outcomes.text: Acquisition of knowledge related to: State of deformation and indefinite congruence equations; State of tension and equilibrium equations of the continuum; Constitutive equations and theorems of the linear elastic body; Plasticity, resistance, and safety criteria.
Ability to apply theoretical knowledge to practical cases concerning the solution of planar elastic beams.

Autonomy of judgment in choosing approaches for structural modeling and analysis, with particular reference to: Determination of stress characteristics in isostatic planar elastic beams; Calculation of the state of stress in the cross-sections of beams using the De Saint Venant model; Safety checks of planar elastic beams.

syllabus_topics: tensore delle deformazioni finite ed infinitesime
dilatazione lineare, angolare, superficiale e cubica
stati di tensione mono- bi- e triassiali
rappresentazione grafica degli stati tensionali (cerchio di Mohr)
teoremi di Clapeyron, Betti e Kirchhoff
problema dell'equilibrio elastico isotropo: equazioni di Navier e di Beltrami-Michell
ipotesi e postulato di De Saint Venant
verifiche di sicurezza (Criteri di Tresca e di Von Mises)

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (solving two exercises: study of an isostatic structure and study of the stress state of a section)
Oral exam (discussion to ascertain knowledge of topics)

assessment_rules: The exam consists of two parts: a written test (approx. 2h 30') with two exercises, and an oral test (not exceeding 30 minutes) focused on the knowledge of topics covered in class. The written test will be taken before the oral test in the same session. In exceptional cases, the oral test may be taken in different sessions, by agreement with the lecturer.
